prior_summary: A redundant Cartesian action predicts both a block-position-anchored world-orientation pose and a destination-frame pose; observed block-bottom clearance blends from the displacement-equivariant low branch to the destination branch over 0.04 m above the tunnel roof.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when block translation beyond demonstrated x/y support is the principal variation, target_pose reliably identifies the open drawer destination, and the observed state is a valid approach, low extraction or clearance-lift state. The drawer should be open above 0.26 and object/TCP observations finite.
termination_guidance: Hand off during the 680:840 overlap after the observed block bottom is above world z 0.16 m, the destination branch dominates, object and TCP motion remain coupled under closed fingers, and transfer toward target_pose has begun while the drawer remains open.
limitations: No out-of-distribution benefit is observed. The 19-D branches can disagree, the height blend is not contact estimation, and noisy object height can switch references incorrectly. The policy cannot retry a missed grasp and does not guarantee collision freedom, IK reachability, drawer preservation or safe large displacement.
